changes.comment: BREAKING (implementers only): IAiClientToolCallSummary gains a required durationMs, measured by executeClientToolTurn around each call's dispatch with an optional clock param; code that builds summaries (fakes, test doubles) must supply it. executeClientToolTurn no longer starts a tool after its signal aborts: it checks before the onBeforeToolExecute gate and again before execute, and reports the call as an isError 'aborted' result. New AiAssist.runClientToolLoop drives bounded multi-round client-tool loops (round cap, whole-loop deadline, caller abort, replace-not-append continuation, observer hooks) and returns completed / round-limit / aborted / deadline outcomes with per-round traces and the final cumulative continuation. New async-control packlet (AsyncControl.raceStopConditions) races Result-returning work against a deadline and a caller signal so work that ignores its signal cannot hold the caller.
